Notes:
----------
*	The original SHNs converted by Mike had Cry Freedom at the end
	of the show.  We found out later that Mark Lynn actually taped
	this show and he says that the Cry Freedom is really the encore
	from 6/16/1993 at the Floodzone.  The only encore was Two Step.

*	Here are Mark's notes:

	"I taped this on my Casio DA 7. I ran straight out of the board andtaped
	onto Denon DT audio grade DAT tape. I used 1 120 and 1 60 min to get the
	whole thing. So Much through Blue Water is contained on the first tape. 
	Pay 4 through the encore Two Step is on the second tape. Cry Freedom is
	not from this show. It is the encore from 6/16/93. I used a 120 minute
	tape for 6/16/93 and had the second tape from 5/19/93 with me in case
	they went over 120 minutes on 6/16/93 so that's the reason for the
	confusion. Two Step was the only encore from 5/19/93. Boyd sure was
	eager to sell T-shirts back then. I played this show on my college
	radio station the following Sunday. It would be pretty weird to come
	across a tape of that broadcast."

Masters Notes:
----------
*	Rebalanced to center, then edited and mastered.
